evidence: Touches mempool policy invariants and test coverage in test/functional/mempool_truc.py and src/test/fuzz/tx_pool.cpp regarding TRUC sibling eviction during reorgs.
rationale: Adds functional and fuzz test coverage ensuring mempool policy checks like TRUC sibling eviction are not erroneously applied during block reorgs. The underlying vulnerability (CVE-2025-62861) was already resolved in #33504, making these additional regression tests worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.
